display_title: How to Survive on an Island
description:
As the only daughter of a duke, far removed from harsh environments and survival, I never expected that humans would pose a greater threat than wild beasts. While frantically fleeing from those threatening me on an island where a cruise ship had wrecked, I encountered Igor, the knight I had personally taken in as a child, whom I had presumed dead. Under his protection, I quickly found peace, as if I had been saved. Before I knew it, a subtle emotion blossomed, a comfort I had never felt with my fiancé...

*"Don't be too surprised."*

Could I be saved once more by him, who had silently stayed by my side for years, claiming to desire my heart and body?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
